claim: The supplier specifies storage of the particle suspension at 2-8 degrees Celsius and states that it must not be frozen.
validity_conditions: A SUPPLIER SPECIFICATION, NOT A LABORATORY LIMIT, and the distinction is the same one that governs the trapping laser's rated power (see trapping_laser_identity). 'The supplier says 2-8 degC and do not freeze' is knowledge and belongs here; 'we keep the tracers at 4 degC' is policy, belongs to a person, and is not written by this seat. Nothing here may be read as a ceiling any mechanism enforces. Note the sheet contradicts itself mildly and both halves are kept rather than reconciled: the Characteristics block says 2-8 degC and the Storage block says 4 degC, which is inside that interval, so the interval is entered and the point value is not. Whether the particles in this laboratory have ever been frozen is unrecorded, and a frozen-and-thawed suspension is a different sample from this one.
